title: Reading Drill — How a Stone Wall Was Rebuilt
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: How a Stone Wall Was Rebuilt
passages.body:
**A** A park needed to repair a low wall built from irregular stones. Workers numbered the loose faces with chalk before any stones were carried to the cutting area.

**B** The largest stones were not always useful at the base. Some had narrow contact surfaces, so the team selected flatter stones to keep pressure spread across a wider area.

**C** A small section was left unfinished for a workshop. Visitors could compare the trial arrangement with a photograph of the wall before repair.
